figures.name: Fig1_instant_and_softening
figures.caption: Actual offline lattice reaction and global damage dissipation under compatible uniform expansion. Envelope excludes unloading branches, which appear in Fig3; instantaneous jump preserved.

figures.name: Fig2_reference_lattice_and_damage
figures.caption: Original full-precision coordinates and edge identities, partial damage, unloaded/reloaded irreversible states, actual partial plane, and fully damaged uniform protocol. Failed connections drawn dashed as identity markers, not active forces.

figures.name: Fig3_work_energy_irreversibility
figures.caption: Full controlled displacement history and all-DOF external work; signed residual shown without clipping. Reversible unloading/reloading at fixed damage, no healing or unexplained energy source.

figures.name: Fig4_energy_control_and_scope
figures.caption: Same initial generalized stiffness and onset, distinct observed irreversible energies. Protocol peak equality does not certify macroscopic strength. Energy budget shown with clearly unachieved reference.
